{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment <= 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows persistent downward drift and true outcome is below model.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is neutral, to avoid underestimating rebounds.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if model is >15% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 10-20% unless sentiment is positive.",
    "Avoid overshoot after sharp spikes: if model rises >10% from prior day’s high, cap forecast at prior high + 5% unless sentiment >0.50.",
    "For sentiment = 0.25 or higher, allow model to slightly overestimate (up to +5%) to capture bullish momentum, but cap at 10% above prior high.",
    "If true outcome is consistently 5-10% below model over 3+ consecutive days, apply downward bias correction by 3-5% per day.",
    "When true outcome is >10% above model, consider sentiment-driven upward bias: increase forecast by 2-5% if sentiment >0.50 and recent price is rising."
  ]
}
